name: 写真を主役にした記事カード
prompt:
Create a standalone photo-led Japanese article card at the exact proportions of the source region (465 x 769 px). Use a white background. Place the supplied exact article photograph as a square, near full-width thumbnail at the top, uncropped. Beneath it, leave the source's clear vertical gap, then add a bold dark Japanese headline on exactly two lines and a muted gray reading-time line below. Match the native Japanese preview for exact wording and Meiryo-like sans-serif character while retaining the source card's image-first hierarchy.
Headline, exactly:
健やかに暮らすため
の、小さな習慣

Reading time, exactly:
読了まで4分

Keep the photo approximately 461 x 461 px at x=0,y=4 and do not alter its content. Keep the title below the image; do not overlay text on the photograph. Do not include the English source headline, buttons, extra labels, or decorative borders.
reviewNotes: v001を目視確認して候補登録。日本語プレビューの見出しと読了時間を反映。写真は確認済みの461×461元アセットを原寸・無損失で合成し、全画素差分0。候補は参照領域の465×769に一致。ネイティブ実装の承認とは別。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
